name: r-csv-summary-cli
title: R CSV Summary CLI
blurb: R CLI: per-column summary (n, mean, min, max, NA count) of a CSV

verify.name: missing-file
verify.cmd:
set +e
Rscript bin/{{ npm_name }} /nonexistent.csv >/dev/null 2>&1
status=$?
echo "exit status: $status"
test "$status" -eq 1

verify.name: summary
verify.cmd:
tmp=$(mktemp).csv
printf 'x,y\n1,2\n3,4\n5,\n' > "$tmp"
out=$(Rscript bin/{{ npm_name }} "$tmp")
echo "$out"
echo "$out" | grep -q 'x 3 3 1 5 0'
rm -f "$tmp"
